Transparent painting price ranges for homeowners across our service area. Every estimate is tailored to your home’s condition, prep needs, and long-term performance — not just a quick coat of paint.

Areas We Serve & How This Page Helps You

We provide painting estimates and completed projects across:

Sugar Land • Missouri City • Richmond • Katy • Fulshear • Rosenberg • Southwest Houston • West Houston

How to Use This Page

  • Start with the price ranges to get a realistic budget expectation

  • Understand what impacts your cost so quotes make sense

  • Move forward with confidence by choosing your project type or scheduling an estimate

Why Our Pricing May Not Look Like the Cheapest Quote

We are not a low-bid painting company — and that’s intentional.

Most paint jobs don’t fail because of the paint itself. They fail because of poor prep, rushed labor, and unclear scope.

Our pricing reflects doing the job correctly the first time.

What You're Actually Paying For

  • Thorough prep work — patching, sanding, caulking, and priming where needed

  • Professional-grade materials designed for durability, not just appearance

  • Skilled crews with consistent standards on every project

  • Clear, detailed scopes of work so there are no surprises

  • Long-term performance — not a quick finish that looks good for a few months

The Reality Most Homeowners Don’t See

It’s common to get multiple quotes that are far apart in price.

That usually comes down to:

  • how much prep is included

  • how detailed the scope is

  • the quality of labor and materials

Lower quotes often skip steps you can’t see — until the paint starts to fail.

Who We’re a Good Fit For

We’re a strong fit if you:

  • Want the job done right the first time

  • Care about durability, not just day-one appearance

  • Appreciate clear communication and detailed estimates

  • Prefer a process you can trust over the lowest price

If you’re simply looking for the cheapest option, we may not be the right fit — and that’s okay.

Exterior Painting Prices

Typical Range: $2,500 – $16,000+

Best for:

  • Full exterior repainting
  • Stucco, brick, siding, and trim
  • Homes needing prep or repairs

Major cost drivers:

  • Home size and accessibility
  • Surface type (stucco, brick, wood, etc.)
  • Prep work and repairs
  • Exposure to sun and weather
View Exterior Prices →

Cabinet Painting Prices

Typical Range: $2,000 – $10,000+

Best for:

  • Kitchen cabinets
  • Bathroom vanities
  • Built-ins and detailed woodwork

Major cost drivers:

  • Number of doors and drawers
  • Prep and sanding requirements
  • Finish type (sprayed vs brushed)
  • Product system used
View Cabinet Prices →

Explore More Before You Decide

Want the full picture before you book? See our preparation process to understand what goes into a finish that lasts, review flexible financing options to fit the project into your budget, and watch real customer video testimonials from homeowners across Fort Bend County. You can also read about our workmanship warranty.

What Drives Painting Costs

If you’ve ever gotten two very different painting quotes, this is why.

Painting isn’t priced randomly — it’s based on how much time, prep, and detail your home actually requires.

Several key factors determine where your project falls within the price range:

  • Project size: Larger homes require more labor and materials

  • Surface condition: Damage, peeling, or previous paint failure increases prep time

  • Prep requirements: The more prep needed, the longer the job — and the better the result

  • Number of colors and finishes: More variation adds time, complexity, and precision

  • Paint products: Higher-quality systems cost more upfront but last significantly longer

  • Detail work: Trim, doors, cabinets, and intricate areas increase labor

  • Access and height: High ceilings, tight spaces, or multi-story exteriors impact efficiency

What’s Included in Our Estimates

Every estimate is built around a clear, detailed scope of work.

Typical inclusions:

  • Surface preparation (cleaning, sanding, patching, caulking)

  • Protection of floors, furniture, and surrounding areas

  • Primer where needed

  • Professional paint application

  • Labor and materials

  • Cleanup and final walkthrough

  • Warranty options

No vague pricing. No hidden fees.

👉 Request a Detailed Painting Estimate

What Impacts Whether You’re at the Low or High End

Lower End of the Range

  • Minimal repairs
  • Standard prep
  • Fewer colors
  • Easy access
  • Simpler layouts

Higher End of the Range

  • Extensive prep or damage repair
  • High ceilings or difficult access
  • Multiple colors or finishes
  • Detailed trim or cabinetry
  • Premium product systems
  • Larger or more complex homes

Want a precise price for your home — not just a range?

Every home is different. The only way to get a precise price is with a detailed walkthrough.

We’ll evaluate your surfaces, explain your options, and provide a clear, written estimate.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to paint a house interior?

Most interior projects range from $3,000 to $20,000+ depending on size, prep, and detail.

What affects the cost of a painting job?

Prep work, repairs, number of colors, surface condition, and product selection all play a major role.

How much does it cost to paint kitchen cabinets?

Cabinet painting typically ranges from $2,000 to $10,000+ based on size, prep, and finish quality.

Are there hidden fees in your estimates?

No. Our estimates are detailed and transparent so you know exactly what you are paying for.

What kind of warranty do you offer?

We offer both 2-year and 5-year workmanship warranties depending on the project scope.

How do unexpected repairs affect pricing?

If we uncover issues mid-project, we communicate clearly and provide options before proceeding.
